notes.title: Patch #1
notes.notes:
Changes:
added a way to change global illumination and reflections. 
added a way to change brightness.
Fixes:
Purrfect trophy fixed and made it so you need to play a full playthrough of game to get trophy.
audio bug with slot machine fixed.
dragging papers in the hospital level sometimes not working fixed
music cues fixed in certain levels.
and many other small fixes

notes.title: First day patch
notes.notes:
Fixes -
Fixed Audio bugs fixes where sound was too quiet and at points do not play at all. 
fixed achievement bugs 
fixed timer 
fixed cat flipping 
fixed cat animations and made them more responsive.
Lastly thank you to everybody that has played this game.
